# GATE PYQ weightage data (auto-generated from PYQ PDFs)

Counts are numbers of questions tagged to each subtopic in the GO-style PYQ books. "All" = every GATE CSE/IT/DA paper in the books (1987-2026); "2015+" = 2015-2026; "2021+" = 2021-2026; "DA" = GATE DA / DS&AI papers only (2024-2026). UGC-NET questions are excluded. Multiple sets per year are counted separately.
